correctness.rationale: In L(K_n) an omitted ab must be the middle of a length-two shortest path between disjoint selected ax and by, so the endpoint neighbor sets must allow different x and y. Failure is precisely an isolated endpoint somewhere or two leaves attached to the same vertex. At the edge-cover bound even n gives a matching; odd n gives one P3 and matching edges, and P3 is forbidden. With n=2k+1 and k+2 edges the component count is k or k−1 by cycle rank. The former forces a triangle and the latter a forest with total excess three over two vertices per component. No 3-vertex tree is allowed, so the unique larger tree has five vertices; any nonpath tree of that size has two leaves with a common neighbor. Matching counts and the 5!/2 path factor then give the census. A matched-edge deletion cannot be repaired. In a triangle, deleting one of three edges allows four attachments per external pair, all slides. In a P5 labeled 1 through 5, each terminal deletion allows only reconnection 15; deleting 23 leaves 12 and 3–4–5, so internally the allowed inserts are 13,15,25,35, with only 15 a jump-only move. Reflecting gives the symmetric internal deletion, and each internal deletion adds four moves per external pair, two slides. This gives all stated degrees. The explicit three-slide sequence swaps one triangle label with one matching label, and using the current triangle label as a buffer for three such exchanges swaps two exterior labels while restoring the triangle. Path states slide to triangle states, yielding odd-order connectivity including the singleton n=3; even states have no moves.
residual_risks: Independent enumeration covered every subset for 3≤n≤6; minima and basis counts obtained were (3,1), (2,3), (4,70), (3,15), in order. At n=5 the degree multisets by multiplicity were jump {10:60,12:10} and slide {8:60,12:10}, each with one component. The infinite result follows from the reasoning, not the finite ranges or supplied expected outputs.
